trap.label: voz passiva
trap.why: O português usa “foram tiradas” e o brasileiro esquece o auxiliar be ou o troca por have. Na passiva sempre há be + particípio.

mcq.q: The story **___** updated an hour ago.

fix.wrong: The newsroom team informed by email yesterday.
fix.right: The newsroom team was informed by email yesterday.

fix.why: Present perfect passivo: has been + particípio.

fix.wrong: The editor’s note will published tomorrow.
fix.right: The editor’s note will be published tomorrow.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para a passiva: “They took the photo.”
Passe para a passiva no futuro: “They will publish the story.”
Passe para a passiva (present perfect): “They have updated the page.”
